title: Tokyo Marathon 2026 Official Program Guidebook — Course detailed map (p.24)
claims: The 2026 course features nine cut-off checkpoints.

The nine cut-off checkpoints and times are: 4.9 km Ichigaya-Mitsuke crossing 10:25; 9.2 km Sudacho crossing 11:10; 15.4 km Hisamatsucho crossing 11:55; 20.9 km Midori 1-chome crossing 12:45; 24.7 km Fukagawa 1-chome crossing 13:20; 29.2 km Asakusabashi crossing 14:00; 33.5 km Sukiyabashi crossing 14:35; 38.5 km Shibakoen Ground-mae crossing 15:15; 42.195 km Tokyo Station/Gyoko-dori Avenue 16:10.
The course map lists 13 medical stations on the course plus start, finish and 10.7 km finish medical stations.
The 10.7 km race finishes at Nihombashi and the marathon finishes at Tokyo Station/Gyoko-dori Avenue at 42.195 km.
The map legend marks medical stations, aid stations, toilets, turnarounds and cut-off points.
